name: vistack
description: Standing entry point for engineering work with sticky routing, evidence-backed playbooks, unattended overnight runs, and merge-ready draft PRs without merging. The canonical command is vistack; run, orchestrator, and coordinator are equivalent aliases.

realm.title: Git realm
realm.description: Host and owner whose repositories the deck may run git and gh against, e.g. github.com/your-org. Empty: no gh PR listing and no lazygit.

jevMode.title: Model suggestions
jevMode.description: off: no suggestion. suggest: show and record the fork layer's model pick. apply: also set it on built-in subagent types that named no model.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Dock the deck when a session starts and the terminal is wide enough.

lazygitLauncher.title: lazygit launcher
lazygitLauncher.description: Where lazygit opens: auto picks tmux inside tmux, else the terminal app.

vistackRoot.title: viStack root
vistackRoot.description: Folder holding scripts/vistack-decision.py; empty finds it beside the deck or in the installed marketplace copy.
